name: Nekoneko Ryokousha: Momoiro Machiokoshi Project!
original_name: 猫猫旅行社 ももいろ町おこしプロジェクト！
source:
Nekomisaki Town-- An old, rural seaside town that's seen better days.
You've been suddenly transferred to work at a local tourism company based there.
The one who greets you upon arrival? Your upbeat senior, Momo Mitsuki.

Not long after you arrive, the two of you are summoned by the company president and handed a huge responsibility:
Lead a town-revitalization project centered around a fireworks festival scheduled for next month!

To bring new life to Nekomisaki,
you and Momo will run all over town. From the fishing port and shopping street to the peach orchards!

The project's name: [Nekomisaki Town's Revitalization Project]
Can the two of you pull it off and light up the town once more?
translation:
猫岬町——一个风光已不如往日的古老海滨小镇。
你突然接到调职通知，要到当地的一家旅游公司工作。
到任时迎接你的是谁？是你开朗的前辈美月桃桃。

你们刚认识没多久，公司社长就把两人叫去，交代了一项责任重大的工作：
以下个月的烟花大会为主轴，带头推动小镇振兴计划！

为了给猫岬町带来新的生机，
你和桃桃将跑遍全镇，从渔港、商店街，一路跑到桃园！

计划的名字就叫“猫岬町振兴计划”。
你们能把它办成，让整座小镇再一次亮起来吗？
